context.transcript:
Good evening.
I apologize for the delay.
We were having some problems with the microphone.
It's my pleasure to present this year's Community Excellence Award to Mary Kebede.
Ms. Kebede's tireless fund-raising made it possible to purchase 5,000 trees to plant throughout our city.
Trees are essential because they improve air quality and cool the environment.
But most importantly, studies have shown that they reduce the symptoms of stress in city residents.
So, on behalf of the community, thank you, Ms. Kebede.
context.transcript_translation:
晚上好。
我为延误表示歉意。
我们麦克风出了点问题。
我很荣幸地向 Mary Kebede 颁发今年的社区卓越奖。
Kebede 女士不懈的筹款工作使得购买 5,000 棵树并在我们城市各地种植成为可能。
树木是必不可少的，因为它们能改善空气质量和冷却环境。
但最重要的是，研究表明它们可以减轻城市居民的压力症状。
所以，我代表整个社区，感谢您，Kebede 女士。
